feedback_try_again.text: Good hustle, take one quick look before the defender closes on you and try that read again!

dzone_tip.text: Protect the house in front of our goalie first, and keep your stick in the passing lane!

ozone_tip.text: Form a triangle with your linemates and get to the slot with your stick on the ice!

feedback_gold.text: Great read, you kept your head up and moved the puck to open ice right on time!

hint.text: Look for your open teammate in the soft ice with their stick on the tape!

intro_default.text: Keep your head up, scan the ice early, and find your open teammate in the slot!
